title: About Northwind Cloud
text: Northwind Cloud is a managed object storage and data pipeline platform founded in 2019. It provides durable blob storage, event-driven pipelines, and analytics tooling for teams building data-intensive applications. Northwind Cloud is headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and serves customers in over 40 countries.

title: Core Products
text: Northwind Cloud offers three core products: Northwind Storage (durable object storage with automatic replication), Northwind Pipelines (event-driven ETL for streaming and batch data), and Northwind Insights (a managed analytics warehouse built on columnar storage).

title: Storage Overview
text: Northwind Storage provides 99.999999999% (eleven nines) annual durability by replicating every object across at least three availability zones. Objects can range from 1 byte to 5 terabytes. Storage classes include Standard, Infrequent Access, and Archive.

title: Storage Pricing
text: Northwind Storage pricing is $0.020 per GB per month for Standard, $0.012 per GB per month for Infrequent Access, and $0.004 per GB per month for Archive. Data retrieval from Archive incurs a $0.03 per GB retrieval fee and takes up to 12 hours.

title: Pipelines Overview
text: Northwind Pipelines lets teams define event-driven data pipelines using a YAML-based DAG configuration. Pipelines can trigger on object upload, on a cron schedule, or via an HTTP webhook. Each pipeline run is logged with full lineage tracking.

title: Pipelines Pricing
text: Northwind Pipelines charges $0.05 per pipeline-run-hour of compute, plus standard data transfer rates. The first 100 pipeline-run-hours per month are included free on all plans.

title: Insights Overview
text: Northwind Insights is a managed columnar analytics warehouse that can query data directly from Northwind Storage without a separate load step, using a feature called Zero-Copy Query. It supports standard SQL and integrates with common BI tools via a Postgres-compatible wire protocol.

title: Insights Pricing
text: Northwind Insights is billed per query based on bytes scanned: $5.00 per terabyte scanned, with a 10 MB minimum charge per query. Materialized views reduce future scan costs by pre-aggregating frequently queried data.

title: Subscription Tiers
text: Northwind Cloud offers three subscription tiers: Starter (free, for evaluation, capped at 10 GB storage and 5 pipeline-run-hours/month), Growth ($299/month, includes 1 TB storage and 500 pipeline-run-hours), and Enterprise (custom pricing, includes dedicated support and a 99.95% uptime SLA).

title: Enterprise SLA
text: The Enterprise tier SLA guarantees 99.95% monthly uptime for the Northwind Storage and Pipelines APIs. If uptime falls below 99.95% in a given month, customers receive a service credit of 10% of that month's bill; below 99.0% uptime, the credit increases to 25%.

title: Security and Compliance
text: Northwind Cloud is SOC 2 Type II certified and ISO 27001 certified. All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Customers on the Enterprise tier can bring their own encryption keys via the Northwind Key Management integration.

title: GDPR and Data Residency
text: Northwind Cloud supports GDPR compliance through configurable data residency: customers can pin storage buckets to the EU (Frankfurt) region to ensure data never leaves the European Union. Data processing agreements are available for all paid tiers.

title: Authentication
text: Northwind Cloud APIs authenticate using API keys or OAuth 2.0 client credentials. API keys are scoped to a project and can be restricted to read-only or read-write permissions. Enterprise customers can enable SSO via SAML 2.0.

title: Rate Limits
text: The Northwind Storage API allows 3,500 PUT/COPY/POST requests per second and 5,500 GET/HEAD requests per second per bucket by default. Enterprise customers can request a rate limit increase through the support portal.

title: Getting Started: Creating a Bucket
text: To create a storage bucket, use the Northwind CLI command `northwind storage create-bucket --name my-bucket --region us-west`. Bucket names must be globally unique, 3-63 characters, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

title: Getting Started: Uploading Objects
text: Objects can be uploaded via the CLI (`northwind storage put my-bucket/path/to/object.json ./local-file.json`), the REST API, or any of the official SDKs (Python, Go, TypeScript, Java). Uploads over 100 MB are automatically split into multipart uploads.

title: Getting Started: First Pipeline
text: A minimal Northwind Pipeline config triggers on object upload and writes a transformed copy to another bucket. Pipelines are defined in a `pipeline.yaml` file and deployed with `northwind pipelines deploy pipeline.yaml`.

title: SDK Support
text: Northwind Cloud maintains official SDKs for Python, Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, and Java. Community-maintained SDKs exist for Ruby and Rust but are not officially supported. All SDKs are open source under the Apache 2.0 license.

title: Webhooks
text: Northwind Storage can send webhook notifications on object create, update, or delete events. Webhook payloads are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature using a per-endpoint secret so recipients can verify authenticity.

title: Incident: 2025-03-14 Storage Latency Spike
text: On March 14, 2025, the us-east-1 region experienced elevated PUT latency (p95 rose from 80ms to 1.2s) for approximately 47 minutes due to a metadata database failover that took longer than expected. Root cause was an under-provisioned connection pool on the failover replica. Fixed by increasing the connection pool size and adding automated failover drills.

title: Incident: 2025-07-02 Pipelines Outage
text: On July 2, 2025, Northwind Pipelines experienced a full outage in the eu-west-1 region for 22 minutes after a bad configuration deploy disabled the pipeline scheduler. The team rolled back the deploy and added a staged-rollout gate to the deployment pipeline to prevent recurrence.

title: Incident: 2025-11-09 Insights Query Errors
text: On November 9, 2025, roughly 3% of Northwind Insights queries returned transient 500 errors for 90 minutes due to a memory leak in a query-planner worker introduced in a release earlier that day. The release was rolled back and a memory-usage regression test was added to the CI pipeline.

title: Support Channels
text: Starter and Growth tier customers get email support with a 24-business-hour response target. Enterprise customers get 24/7 support via a dedicated Slack Connect channel with a 1-hour response target for Sev-1 incidents.

title: Data Deletion and Retention
text: Deleted objects in Northwind Storage are immediately unlisted but retained in a soft-deleted state for 30 days by default (configurable per bucket, 0-90 days) before permanent, unrecoverable deletion. Customers can disable soft-delete for buckets containing no sensitive data to reduce storage costs.

title: Versioning
text: Bucket versioning, when enabled, keeps every previous version of an object instead of overwriting it. Versioning is recommended for buckets storing configuration files or anything where accidental overwrites would be costly, but increases storage costs proportionally to the number of versions retained.

title: Multi-Region Replication
text: Enterprise customers can enable Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to automatically copy objects from a source bucket to a destination bucket in a different region, typically completing replication within 15 minutes of upload. CRR is billed at standard storage and data transfer rates for the replica.

title: Northwind Insights Materialized Views
text: Materialized views in Northwind Insights are refreshed on a schedule you define (as often as every 5 minutes) and are billed for the bytes scanned during each refresh, not for storage. They are most cost-effective for dashboards queried more than a few times per day.

title: Migrating from Other Providers
text: Northwind Cloud provides a free migration tool, `northwind-migrate`, that supports importing objects directly from Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, and Azure Blob Storage buckets, preserving metadata and object ACLs where possible.

title: Billing and Invoicing
text: Northwind Cloud bills monthly in arrears based on metered usage. Enterprise customers can request annual prepaid invoicing with a 10% discount. All plans support payment by credit card; Enterprise plans also support ACH and wire transfer.

title: Deprecation Policy
text: Northwind Cloud provides a minimum of 12 months' notice before deprecating any public API endpoint or SDK major version, communicated via email, the status page, and in-console banners. Security-critical deprecations may have a shorter notice period.

title: Status Page and Uptime History
text: Real-time and historical uptime information for all Northwind Cloud services is published at status.northwindcloud.example. Over the trailing 12 months, Northwind Storage has maintained 99.98% uptime and Northwind Pipelines has maintained 99.96% uptime.

title: Free Tier Limits
text: The Starter (free) tier is capped at 10 GB of storage, 5 pipeline-run-hours per month, and 50 GB of Insights query scanning per month. Exceeding these limits pauses further usage until the next billing cycle unless the account is upgraded.
